purpose: Derived OLD→CURRENT survey for App Atlas / Atlas Dayline lineage. It helps recover bearings; it does not become project authority.
laws: MECHANISM MAY SURVIVE AFTER PRODUCT NAME DIES
CURRENT CONTROL FILES OWN CURRENT STATE; THIS FILE IS A DERIVED CROSSWALK
ATLAS DAYLINE REMAINS A STABLE TEMPORAL DONOR, NOT A SECOND CONTROL PLANE
PROJECTION MUST RETAIN SOURCE / IDENTITY / RETURN
UNRESOLVED MEANS NO CLAIM, NOT ABSENCE

keep: stable task identity across ATLAS ↔ PLAIN projections
anchors + time windows + temporal opportunity field
bounded RUN with evidence-bearing RETURN / REPLAY
plain-list ablation as a check against spatial ornament
do_not_promote: Atlas Dayline as repository truth authority
radial geometry when a plain projection is clearer

vectors.label: IDENTITY → UNEQUAL PROJECTIONS
vectors.retained: Keep object identity fixed while views, scale and reach change.

vectors.label: CAPTURE → CANON → RE-ENTRY
vectors.retained: Capture once; separate proposal from committed truth; preserve ancestry and source class.

vectors.label: LINEAGE → DELTA
vectors.retained: Show meaningful state change without creating a second journal.

vectors.label: MECHANISM TRANSFER
vectors.retained: Move a mechanism only after naming invariant, destination translation and falsifiable test.

vectors.label: TIME AS PROJECTION
vectors.retained: Anchors constrain; opportunities flex; time changes reach, not identity.

vectors.label: RETURN AS GLOBAL INVARIANT
vectors.retained: Compression and execution must preserve a source/evidence/re-entry path.

vectors.label: GLYPH AS COMPRESSED PROJECTION
vectors.retained: Glyph carries selected identity/state; richer source semantics remain host-side residue.

vectors.label: SOCIAL RESIDUE WITHOUT AUTO-COMMIT
vectors.retained: Remember, draft and hand off; do not silently turn communication into obligations or sends.

vectors.label: RAW SOURCE → REVIEWED CASE
vectors.retained: Preserve raw source, conflicts and unknowns; canonicalize only after review.

vectors.label: WORLD AS EVIDENCE GATE
vectors.retained: Abstraction pays rent through observable world state and changed consequences.
